user.title: C-Bus PC Interface
user.description: Choose the serial port of your C-Bus PC Interface (5500PC, 5500PCU or 5500PACA), or type the address of an Ethernet interface (5500CN), eg tcp://192.168.1.50:10001. Stop any other software using it (cbus2mqtt, C-Gate) first.

group_types.title: What each group controls
group_types.description: Lights are dimmable by default. Choose "On/off light" for relay channels, "Blind / curtain" for shutter relays and "Fan" for fan controllers. Blinds, fans and switches are untested on real hardware: please report how they work for you.

pac_programming_mode.title: C-Bus PAC needs restarting
pac_programming_mode.description:
The Pascal Automation Controller (5500PACA) is answering in its programming protocol instead of acting as a PC Interface. It only switches modes from a fresh start: power-cycle the C-Bus network, or unplug the PAC's USB cable, wait 10 seconds and plug it back in. Resetting USB from Home Assistant isn't enough. C-Bus will reconnect automatically.

Note: while a PAC is used as a PC Interface its own logic program does not run.

remove_group.description: Remove a group address and its entity. It isn't added back automatically, even if it's seen on the network.
